title: Problem details
description: RFC 9457 problem detail document. Extension members are allowed by the RFC.

type.description: URI identifying the problem class, e.g. https://acme.example/problems/payment-declined.

title.description: Stable, human-readable summary of the problem class.

status.description: HTTP status code of this occurrence, where the transport has one.

instance.description: Identifier of this occurrence, usually the request or order id.
